kbArticles.title: Refund timelines and how to track a refund
kbArticles.body:
When a refund is approved it is sent to your bank the same working day.

Most refunds appear within 5 to 7 working days. Card refunds can take up to 10 working days depending on the bank.

If a refund has not arrived after 10 working days, ask the customer for the refund reference number and raise a trace request with the payment gateway. Do not promise a specific date until the trace comes back.

Duplicate charges are refunded automatically within 48 hours of detection.

kbArticles.title: Fixing app crashes and freezing
kbArticles.body:
Crashes and freezing are usually caused by an outdated app version or a corrupt local cache.

First ask the customer to update the app. Version 4.2 and above contains the stability fix for checkout, loading and search screens.

If the problem persists after updating, ask them to clear the app cache from device settings and sign in again.

If it still fails, collect the device model, OS version and app version and escalate to engineering with reproduction steps.

kbArticles.title: Returns policy, pickup and damaged items
kbArticles.body:
Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for any reason.

To start a return the customer opens the order in their account and selects Return. A courier pickup is scheduled within two working days.

Damaged or wrong items are collected and replaced at no cost. Ask for a photograph of the item and the packaging before arranging collection.

Once the returned item reaches the warehouse it is inspected within two working days, after which the refund is approved.
